opportunities.title: Native ownership of secret operations and lifetimes
opportunities.summary: An option that consolidates secret generation, KDF, AEAD, and disposal in one engine.
opportunities.diagnosis: Secret operations and immutable key objects are currently distributed across the Python KEM, schedule, and records.

desiredInvariants: No secret-dependent branch/address/loop/variable-size allocation before explicitly authorized final Finished/AEAD acceptance or output declassification; internal KEM validity remains private.
No raw SK/ss/KDF/AEAD key exports in native productionAPI.
Fail closed on entropy/native failure; preserve one-shot and nonce ownership.
Explicit lifetime and wipe-before-free for owned buffers without claiming every hardware copy is erased.
Every outbound frame has a single-use pending-write ticket; every payload feed requires the exact approved-header receive permit.
Recoverable checked errors and containable Rust panics do not imply ABI UB or segmentation faults can be caught safely.
